bounded_veto.finding: AppraisalAcceptanceReceipt.build() is callable by the consumer and validate() checks internal hash consistency only. A caller can choose trust_eligibility=true plus arbitrary non-empty verifier/policy/registry identifiers and acceptance route, then compute a matching receipt hash. That proves self-consistency, not that the canonical appraisal path actually issued or accepted the receipt.

The issuer/registry identity, installation/workspace identity, verifier envelope, appraisal policy, anchor registry and acceptance record must be verified; acceptance_route must be versioned/enumerated rather than free text.
